features.quote: Termination condition: max turns or explicit stop.
6–12 agent turns per run is a good default.
features.justification_quote: Too many turns will create noise and cost.

features.quote: Do not use abusive or humiliating prompts.
features.justification_quote: You want failure under ambiguity, not emotional harassment.

features.quote: Even though this is an eval, there are a few design concerns.
